notes: Exact original UMD College Park workbook from the official archive. Headline C1 totals reconcile male/female and all reported gender/status cells; 2021 onward explicit overall totals are also checked. The original XLS format in 2007–09 and 2012 is handled by a separate Excel adapter.
expected.review_method: Independent reading of original C1 gender/status/residency cells and reconciliation with printed totals where provided. Additional source-extracted metrics are not all manually verified.
